title: Relay connection claims
responsibility: Reads syntactically valid host or device connection claims from request headers.

inputs.name: connectClaims.headers
inputs.description: Headers containing Bearer authorization and the protocol role/device headers. The Bearer scheme is case-insensitive; the credential must match the protocol pattern.

outputs.name: connectClaims
outputs.description: Host claims with an empty device identifier, or device claims with a valid protocol device identifier. Returns undefined for missing/malformed credential, unknown role or invalid device identity.
